random_source_rows: NumPy default_rng(seed).permutation(base_row_count); first4096 for training, next20000 for searched base. Independent subsequent permutation(query_row_count), first200 for queries.
value_disjoint_control: Same seeded source permutation and training rows; scan later base rows excluding training values until20000 accepted. Scan query permutation excluding all selected training/base values until200 accepted.
exact_value_comparison: Finite float32 row bytes with signed zero normalized; report train/base, train/query and base/query match counts.
interpretation: Exploratory validation against source-order artifacts; retain prefix runs, all outcomes, and source-index/hash provenance. No pooling across different splits.
